patterns.name: fps_get_default_cap
patterns._comment: GetDefaultFramerateCap clamps default framerate cap to 240. Patch to mov w9, w8.

patterns.name: fps_taskscheduler_fallback_60
patterns._comment: TaskScheduler getTargetFps fallback 60 FPS (mov w8, #60). Patch to mov w8, #10000.

patterns.name: fps_taskscheduler_dt
patterns._comment: TaskScheduler target framerate dt clamp (cmp w11, #240; mov w12, #240; csel). NOP csel to uncap.

patterns.name: fps_taskscheduler_frametime_calc
patterns._comment: TaskScheduler target frametime calculator 240 clamp (cmp w23, #240; mov w8, #240; csel). Patch to mov w8, w23.

patterns.name: fps_adaptivesync_schedule
patterns._comment: AdaptiveSync schedule target framerate (ldr w8, [x0, #0x118]; cmp w8, #1; csinc). Set to 10000 to uncap.

patterns.name: fps_adaptivesync_refresh
patterns._comment: AdaptiveSync refresh clamp bypass (cmp w21, w22; csel). NOP csel to uncap.

patterns.name: fps_displaytiming_pacing
patterns._comment: DisplayTiming::schedule in-game frame pacing clamps CADisplayLink maximumFrameRate to screen refresh rate (60/120). Patch to mov w8, w22; ucvtf s1, w22.

patterns.name: fps_devicemtl_present_timing
patterns._comment: DeviceMtl presentFrame branches to presentDrawable:atTime: when targetTimestamp > 0. Patch b.le to unconditional b to present immediately.
